messages.author: 648de078c75a9b6b
messages.subject: Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "manifold") : File 'C:*.manifold' does not exist
parts:
Hi,

While trying to run inla.mesh.2d or inla.mesh.create using any of the example codes provided with INLA, I get the following error message:

Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "manifold") : 
  File 'C:/******/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmp0qEQfm/fmesher14cc31011155.manifold' does not exist.

Additionally, when I try to run code that contains the inla function, already including verbose=TRUE, I get this error message, possibly related to the problem:

The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does help; please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.
In addition: Warning messages:
1: running command 'C:\Windows\system32\cmd.exe /c @"C:\******\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp0qEQfm\file14cc5fd96aea.BAT"' had status 1 
2: In shell(paste("@", shQuote(bat.file), sep = ""), wait = TRUE) :
  '@"C:\******\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp0qEQfm\file14cc5fd96aea.BAT"' execution failed with error code 1

I have full control access rights to the folder in question. I get the same error message in admin mode. I have the latest INLA version & R 3.0.2. .libPaths points to a folder to which I also have full control access rights. Running library(INLA) does not give any error messages. I am running this on Windows 7. Everything else runs without problems in R. I didn't have this problem with INLA with my previous laptop (that wasn't Winows 7.) Can you please help me to understand what could be the reason why my INLA installation is not working?

Thanks!

> Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "manifold") :
> File 'C:/******/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmp0qEQfm/fmesher14cc31011155.manifold' does not exist.

This usually happens when the input data is ambiguous for the mesh, but
that should not happen for the examples, so it's more likely that it has
to do with your system setup.

> Additionally, when I try to run code that contains the *inla *function,
> already including *verbose=TRUE*, I get this error message, possibly
> related to the problem:

It the first error _wasnt't_ due to the system setup, this error
is possibly a direct result of the first error; since it didn't create a
mesh, you cannot then use it in the later code. But it's likely that
both errors are due to a problem with the system setup.

Unfortunately I don't have any windows machines to test on. Hopefully
Håvard has an idea of what could be wrong.

Finn L

messages.author: 8fc1259ac1064a93
messages.subject: Re: Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "manifold") : File 'C:*.manifold' does not exist
parts:
I ran into the same issue.  These two things fixed it:

1) Run INLA:::inla.dynload.workaround()
2) Make sure that the values in the triangles matrix range from 1:V, not 0:(V-1).  The latter seems to be common.

Hope this helps.
Amanda

parts:

Dos a basic minimal inla() model run? If yes, then it's not a binaries issue.

I'm not sure of the R4.1 status for the I la binary builds, but that should not matter for the mesh building code.

Finn
